title: Buy something else…
text: Buy something else…. I have no idea how anyone succeeded in making these work. Paid $10 more for a higher quality set. Worth the extra money. These were evil.

product_metadata.title: Shoe Storage, 12 Pack Large Shoe Boxes Clear Plastic Stackable, Shoe Organizer Containers with Lids for Size 13
features: 【Item Dimension】: Overall Assembled Size: 13.7(L) x 9.8(W) x 7.5(H) inches/35(L) x 25(W) x 19(H)cm, suitable for men's shoes in size 12 and women's shoes in size 13. Facing the messy shoe storage space, this stackable plastic shoe box can be the best choice.

【Why Choose us】: More Space + Aromatherapy Stick + Magnet Door + Ventilation Holes. The shoe box fits sizes up to men's US 12. Aromatherapy Stick and Large ventilation hole ensure air circulation and odor prevention. The door magnet can make the door close tighter, not easy to fall. Heels, flats, sneakers, flip flops, sandals, wedges and more, just put them in.

【Stackable Shoe Box】: The shoe box can be tightly connected up and down, you only need to lift the top one shoe box, then the whole row of shoe boxes can be removed together without falling. These stackable storage bins can be arranged to suit various spaces e.g. entryway, closet, under the bed, cabinet, drawers.

【Material Composition】: The shoe organizer is made of healthy and non-toxic environmentally friendly plastic. Sturdy and durable, due to the use of plastic materials, the shoe box enjoys good waterproofs and can be washed with water. Lightweight soft plastic is used around the shoe box, and hard plastic is used for the door frame, which is very stable after assembly.

【Save Space】: Stacking Storage Shoe Box help to simply organize closets and living areas, folding design makes each one easy to put together and folds into shape. When not in use, quickly unfolds for easy and convenient storage to save space.
